paragraphs.source_en: “Forgive my boldness, but Your Lordship the Shogun said a moment ago that you too bear responsibility for this affair.”

paragraphs.source_en: Kōetsu appeared to have anticipated this command. He straightened his posture and bowed deeply and respectfully to Ieyasu. “I shall do what little lies within my power.”
